nom: Patchology Serve Chilled On Ice Cooling & Firming Under Eye Gel Patches

avis.texte: Slip right off constantly. Such wasteful packaging for each pair. Rarely stay where placed.
I LOVE this gel mask- warm or cold seasons, this is the perfect boost to the face.
These are so cooling and feeling perfect when you want to refresh your skin!

These are some of my favorite eye patches because they truly give that cooling sensation and they literally help me wake up in the mornings!! I love how they don't slide off of my face and they just make my eyes look so much more awake I can't say enough good things about them!
I love the 'On Ice' line of products, and the eye firming eye gels do not disappoint. Each eye gel has lots of product that soothes, smooths and brightens.

I received an On Ice face mask in a gift bag for my birthday. I don't usually like face masks, but this one is different. I chilled it in the refrigerator and used it on a hot afternoon. It was soothing, smoothing and a real treat. My skin was instantly soothed and brightened. Now I always keep a mask or two in the refrigerator for a cooling treat.

I'm loving these Patchology Serve Chilled On Ice Firming Eye Gels! They are amazingly cooling if you chill them in the fridge overnight! They also work well at room temperature. I feel like these help improve the overall look and feel of my under eye area. The ingredients include peptides, cloudberry oil, and bakuchiol which are all things my skin tends to like! These are excellent eye gels and I can say I recommend them!
Love putting these in the fridge & applying in the am for refreshed eyes.

avis.titre: Refreshing treat for your under eyes
avis.texte: Great to start your day or end your evening with a refreshing treat for your self care.
Great for after sun or for a chill night. Definitely a great product for your self care routine
This mask was very hydrating. You can put it in the refrigerator for an extra cooling effect. It only takes 5 minutes to see and feel softer more hydrated skin.

these are definitely not my favorite eye patches just because there's some that make my eyes feel more hydrated and make my dark circles go away for a better price point but these were fun to use, I don't love their packaging though because they're wet and then it's like hard to open, so it's hard to actually get to the eye patches. I also felt like they sat weird on my face, but that's probably just my face. honestly I might pay these again sometime just for fun, but I'll probably be sticking to the ones I normally buy because they do better for a better price point. but you might try them and these become your favorite!
These eye patches are super cooling under the eyes! I love to put them in the fridge for even more depuffing. They keep my under eyes hydrated and glowing!

I love the Serve Chilled on Ice eye gels because my under eye area gets really puffy and these do an amazing job at de-puffing my under eye area. They also help to hydrate my under eye area, which as a dry skin girl, I really appreciate. As per usual for patchology products, these sit on my under eye area nicely and don't slip, so I am able to do other things while the eye patches are at work!

I don't know that these eye patches do anything to remove puffiness or firm my under eyes to be honest, but I will say, if you put them in the fridge and put them on especially after a night of drinking or lack of sleep, it feels amazing. They definitely wake you up!

I love the ones that I refrigerate. This was first time trying this one and 10/10 will get it again. Not entirely sure it did a lot for my puffy face but have had sinus issues recently. Either way it felt great and was cooling / relaxing to have on.

These are actually the worst eye patches I've ever used and I normally don't review eye patches, but within seconds of putting these on my under eyes, they're sliding down my cheeks… Absolutely terrible compared to some of the other ones out there
PATCHOLOGY eye patches are the best! I love these ones as they are cooling and depuff your under eyes. Love it!
These make my eyes ferl nice and cool and do a great job at depuffing my under eyes.

I bought a single pack to try, which came with 2 under eye patches. They are extremely slippery and were sliding down my cheeks the whole 5 minutes. They would not stay under my eyes at all. The gel doesnt grip to your skin no matter what you try.

I'm not even kidding about the title. As soon as I opened it, it was a wave of old lady perfume basically. I gave it a shot anyways and one of them kept slipping down my face. Yay for the product but nah for me actually being able to wear them and have the benefits seep in without having to constantly push it back up my cheek.
Never used eye patches before. Felr very soothing and stuck to my under eye for over an hour!
So fabulous. I haven't tried to pu them in the fridge yet. Cool on their own. 🩵
Loved these patches! Worked so well and stayed on for a while would recommend!!!

avis.titre: Cooling felt great, scent was too strong
avis.texte: The cooling sensation was refreshing, however I could not keep the patches in place. They would slide down my face constantly unless I laid down. The scent was not my favorite but I am very sensitive to fragrences.

I was looking for under eye patches to replaces the dot dot dash under eye patches from patchology. These are not comparable at all! However they will definitely feel refreshing under your tired eyes! And immediately take away puffiness. All in all they are are good eye patch, but im not into the gel/ silicone feel.

why so much plastic in the packaging? I had a hard time getting these out of the package.. like they weren't cut all the way through and came as one piece. also these rip/snag if you're not super careful about getting them out. they slide off of my face. I have to lay down to wear them so they're not my favorite
I love these eye patches. I put them in the fridge so they are extra cool and refreshing when I go to use them. Highly recommend them to anyone!
These patches feel great on tired eyes. I put them in the fridge for about 5 minutes and they were just cool enough. I would use them every day.
I'm on my third set of on ice eye gels , they're so GOOD for the morning routine ! It's a great way to start your morning and to refresh your under eyes !! Nothing is better than a nice chill!

I bought two sets as the reviews were promising, but the fragrance on them was a very heavy perfume scent. It was way to much for me. I removed them within minutes and even after a double cleanse, the scent lingered on my skin. I have no idea if they work well. Tossed the 2nd pair. Beware if you are sensitive to fragrance.

Reading the description, I was excited to try. First issue I had was the patches wouldn't stay on; they kept falling off. I've used many brands and never had this happening. Next there was not much cooling but a lot of burning. Definitely wouldn't recommend

So refreshing and hydrating, plus only need to stay on for 5 minutes, with option to wear longer if you choose to. My undereye area was morr hydrated appearing and dark shadows under eyes was less pronounced. Will definitely be repurchasing.

This was a bit disappointing for me. The cost is certainly reasonable, but the added perfume scent is pretty horrible. I don't see why that's needed. I am a bit sensitive to added perfume smells, and this one really bothered me. I've used plenty of different eye masks across budgets, and none of them were as strongly perfumed as these.
I love having my skincare moment with my cooling eye gels; it's so relaxing. It really makes the area around my eyes look younger and firmer. I highly recommend it!

I absolutely love these under eye patches. The shape is perfect, and I really like that you can place them in different ways depending on what you want to target (under eyes, outer corners, or even higher up for lifting). They're super hydrating and feel so soothing—especially if you keep them in the fridge. They are a little slippery and can slide around at first, but if you apply slight pressure when placing them, it's not a big issue. I usually just lay down while wearing them anyway, so they stay put and feel extra relaxing. Overall, they're easy to apply and give my under eyes a really fresh, plump look

I love these eye gels, they're really cooling and make me feel so relaxed. I really like using them, especially when I have puffy eyes; they really hydrate the skin and make the skin around my eyes look brighter.
they work so well, one time i got day drunk in miami and had to rally later and these really made my face look normal after my day drinking nap.
The "On Ice" eye patches are truly Icy! They feel great and work wonders!
So refreshing! Feel amazing!! Especially after those nights when you just didn't get enough sleep. Will continue to buy
Felt hydrating but kept sliding down my face. Couldn't get them to stay on long enough to see any benefit
These were my first time try and i definitely noticed a difference
These eye patches make me feel amazing. I like to do them before I get ready for the day, and they allow for easy makeup application! I will continue to use these.

I was looking forward to using these patches and loved the idea I was able to put them in the fridge, however they do not stay put! They consistenly slid from my undereye and I tried both in the fridge and without and both times it was an issue. They seem like they're hydrating, but I unfortunately wasn't able to see the benefits because they didn't stay put. I'm wondering if perhaps mine were defective after seeing all the great reviews, so maybe I'll repurchase and try again.
These are so nice and really help de-puff my eyes in the morning.

I love eye mask and was so excited for this mask and sadly. This is the worst mask I have ever used within the five minutes that I'm supposed to apply. It kept falling down would not stay under my eyes. I had to keep readjusting and I saw no benefit. if you gave this to me for free, I would still throw it away. It's not worth the cost.
Nothing beats these individually wrapped eye gels when you put them on fresh out of the fridge. It truly feels like an indulgence 😍 You feel fresh and awake after!
These are my favorite eye patches and I've tried many other brands.

I used these eye patches one time and was impressed by how it reduced my fine lines and gave me a hydrated appearance with just one use, however there was not much of a change in my dark circles. I had to lay down while using thrm otherwise they wouldve kept sliding down my face.
The cooling feels amazing, and when your done, all your puffiness is gone.
I got these eye patches to have for the whole family to use on the last night of our vacation. They felt really good!
The eye patches are cooling and feels refreshing but they slid down all the time!

avis.titre: Slides off the face but hydrating!
avis.texte: These slide off the eyes and don't stay up so can't recommend! They do feel cool and relaxing and the serum is very hydrating on them.
These patches feel great in the skin. I have sensitive skin but have no problem with these. They cool and depuff under my eyes. Recommend after a long night.

I'm a mother of six, and i am so tired all the time and some days you can see it under my eyes. love this product, the cooling semsation feels amazing and it depuffs my eyes amazingly. Also my husband drove for 20 hours and his under eyes looked bad, but after using this twoce he is back to normal. 10/10 recommend.

These collagen infused eye patches are soothing and helpful too.
These really, really work!!! I will definitely be buying them again. Love it!
Really helps reduce swelling under eyes in morning. Haven't found anything else that works better than these. I found some other ones in Japan but doesn't work as good. Just a little expensive .
I keep these in the fridge and use on mornings my eyes need a de-puff and boost.
Patchy never disappoints. These little guys are so cooling and refreshing to my morning eyes. It's just the right amount of cool and hydration.
I love all of the eye patches, but these are my favorite for more often use.
Love them! Using my points and monthly subscription for Christmas presents.

These are probably my favorite eye gels from Patchology. They are so soothing and cooling. I love using them first thing in the morning to calm puffiness under my eyes. I love that you can see the effect in as little as 5 minutes. Perfect for a busy morning, although I always try to leave them on as long as possible. My hack is to wear them while I am blow drying my hair. They never slip when I am moving around, which is a huge plus!
I have been using this in my treatment room for my clients under-eyes and everyone raves about the results they see and feel afterwards!
I absolutely love these eye masks! They make my under eyes glow! Will never use another eye mask again :)
I usually use the flash patch, but I like this one better especially over the summer with the heat.. it's so refreshing in the morning.
I love these eye patches! They are a great value in the jar and feel great on tried mom eyes
I use this in the morning to depute my under eyes. I put it in the fridge the night before so it is nice and cold for me in the morning. It helps wake me up! Love it!

avis.titre: The best feeling after a night out
avis.texte: Absolutely love these, they're so refreshing to use in the morning after a night out. Stick them in the fridge over night and pop em on in the morning and it's the best way to start your day!
For the price it does its job . Glad I found this at ulta in a box ..just one pack is not enough . I use them daily ..

These eyepatches are my holy grail (and now my husband's too)! I keep them in the fridge for extra refreshment and often use them while writing in my morning journal. My eyes look and feel more awake and refreshed!
Put this container in the fridge and they were so soothing on tired puffy eyes!

These are in my top 2 mask cjhoices, super cooling on the eyes, great peptide blend, put these in the fridge for a super charged cooling effect. Always part of our Skincare event lineup. These make great goodie bag gifts too!
I have not seen my dark circles so light in years. these are soooo good.
Love these eyes patches so much! They are so good and work so well! Always part of my routine!
I love how cooling these under-eye gels are. They instantly depuff and brighten my under-eye area...These under-eye gels are a quick pick-me-up! Noticeably reduced puffiness.
I've used all of the patches and they are all great, and a great value.

These eye patches use cooling and a serum to rid you of puffy undereyes. And they do work—but I have to keep re-positioning them into place. Thats the reason for the one-star ding. Ive used undereye patches before. These are heavier and slide out of position constantly throughout the wear time. In envelopes these are great for travel, so I recommend them for that purpose. Stick them in an insulated lunch bag with a chilly pCk, and they can be used on arrival. Or pop them into the hotel room's refrigerator. Fir at home, though, pick another brand thats not so thick and thus heavy.
I love applying these after a long day of work! So cooling and relaxing!
I love how hydrated and smooth my eyes look after using these under eye gels! Gentle but effective.
Decided to try these during sale. Like others i agree these don't stay on. I dont see a difference when i use them.

I made it all the way through a five pack of these. When I used the fifth pair, these gave me a mild chemical burn under one of my eyes. I will not use facial products with a cooling ingredient anymore.

Not overly impressed with these, there are better eye gels out there. I put them in the fridge like most recommend. They don't stay on that well and I reallt didn't notice a difference when using them.

I had a wedding in the afternoon and had the worst case off puffy eye when I woke up that morning. I ran to ulta and after seeing the reviews for this product I decided to give it a try. I dont usually have good luck with eye gels, but this worked AMAZINGLY. I'm going back today to get more!

I was skeptical about these at first but after giving them a try, I was blown away. I stored mine in the fridge and wore them for 10 minutes tops. I highly recommend if you need a quick pick-me-up! My eye bags felt nourished and soo smooth afterwards
I love these stored in the fridge for a refreshing pick me up. Sad to see the packs went from 6 to 5.

I recently tried all of the available patches, and these are my favorite! I keep them in the refrigerator, so when I use them they are ice cold and feel so good on my skin. My eyes and the area around it gets irritated a lot and I put these on, and my eyes feel like icy bliss! Along with the great ingredients of peptides and bakuchiol. Makes my eyes look and feel icy firm!

I think they work amazing I felt a little tired and nervous and notice my eyes were really puffy before a job interview. I used this product and relax for 10 minutes. And let me say they were so amazing. Calmed my nerves too and got the job on the spot.
Believe me when I tell you I have tried a lot of eye patches over the years, these are my new favorites. They actually work, depuff my chronically puffy eyes.
I have used this in the morning while getting ready after washing my face. I love to rub in the excess gel.
These feel SO good on the undereyes! I keep mine in the fridge They do fall easily with movement

avis.titre: Wish these also came in a 30 pair set
avis.texte: These are nice and cooling and help wake me up in the morning. The formula has noticeably helped with the dark circles under my eyes. It also tones my skin, so my red cheeks and nose change color to match the rest of my face. I'm just disappointed that the On Ice eye gels are not available yet in a 30 pair set. I love these. So I'll be patiently waiting for the day a 30 pair set of Served Chilled On Ice set is available. Here or at Ulta Beauty.
These eye patches are great! Easy to apply and remove. I don't use patches all that often but these are my go to.

avis.titre: I wanted to love these, but...
avis.texte: There's too much slip. The eye gels don't stay in place; they slip down. Also wish they came in bulk packaging, as the single-use is wasteful. Received other Patchology eye gel samples with this order and hoping I like one of those better.
Love all of the varieties of patches, especially the ones that you put in the fridge for added cooling and refreshment.

I love all of Patchology's eye gels but I think by far this is my favorite. They have a cooling sensation on the face I really adore. It's very comfortable and hydrating. I don't have any issues with slipping and sliding. Just a lot of depuffing and hydrating which is a must for me.
Miracle eye pads! Immediate results. I absolutely love them and will buying more as gifts to give to friends and family for the holidays.

Omg I loved putting this in the fridge. After a hot day of yard work this felt amazing on my eyes after my shower omg. I love anything that cools!! It deff took away the hot red look I had. This is perfect for depuffing!!
I keep these in my fridge for the extra chill affect! So cooling! Have used them only three times but I am seeing the difference in the darkness around my eyes already!
These eye masks are just so good!! Keep them in the fridge, they will work even better! They leave such a hydrated and de puffed eyes area
This mask is amazing for my morning puffiness Works even better when kept in the fridge A forever repurchase
This mask is amazing for my morning puffiness Works even better when kept in the fridge A forever repurchase
Love it so much! Perfect after a day at work The packaging is also very convenient for travelling Very refreshing
I mainly use these in short flights to look and feel refreshed when I land. They are also great at home for a girls spa day which I do all the time!
I love these eye gel patches! Put them in the fridge to cool and use the regularly, you will notice a difference.
I am 68 years old. These cold patches (I keep in fridge) are soothing under my eyes, and do help with puffiness and brighten up the skin.

avis.titre: In love with these Eye Gels!
avis.texte: Might be my favorite eye gels yet, they are so refreshing on my under eyes! I pop them in my fridge as well to keep them cooler. I love them in the morning to wake me up and my skin.
